shortDescription: The Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean has made a credit line of up to $50 million available for Panama after a magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck the southern part of the country on Friday.Additionally, the bank made a $250,000 donation to the country, it said in a post on X.
